notes: Render-complete result is now a full-screen 'video ready' takeover in Scene (list) view, with an Edit-scenes button. Generating from the non-timeline (List) view previously popped the same centred modal as the Timeline view; now showRenderDoneModal checks getSceneViewMode() and, when not 'timeline', adds an .rdm-screen-mode class that turns the existing #renderDoneModal overlay into an opaque full-page screen (var(--bg-page) background, top-aligned, scrollable) instead of a translucent popup — mirroring how Text to Video already presents as a modal in Timeline view but its own screen in List view. The screen shows the same true-aspect-ratio player + Download/TikTok/Instagram from v1.4.77, plus a new '✏️ Edit scenes' button (rdm-edit, hidden via CSS unless screen mode) wired to rdmEditScenes(): it closes the screen, switchTab('scenes'), setSceneViewMode('list') and scrolls to top so the user lands on the scene list to edit. Timeline view keeps the centred modal unchanged (Edit button stays hidden). closeRenderDoneModal clears both 'open' and 'rdm-screen-mode'. Added rdm_edit i18n (en 'Edit scenes' / ja 'シーンを編集'). Verified in-browser: List mode = opaque screen + visible Edit; Timeline mode = translucent modal, Edit hidden; Edit click closes the overlay and lands on the active scenes list (list mode); no console errors.
